text:
rachel: Heads-up: intermittent nvme I/O "ping-pong" on us-west3 node causing GPU attach latency. noticed after overlayfs flag change last night.
aj: node id?
rachel: gnode-uw3-402, started ~08:12 UTC. dmesg shows repeating blk_update_request errors every ~8-10s.
devon: can you grab SMART and dmesg snippet?
rachel: smartctl shows media_errors incrementing and bad_blocks rising; wear ~69%. dmesg excerpt: 
[08:12:05] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1
[08:12:14] I/O timeout
[08:12:22] I/O completed
[08:12:31] blk_update_request: I/O error
aj: ~9s gap. matches janitor/trim cadence we adjusted. could be cleaner colliding with small-R/W batches.
sofia: overlayfs mount flag change increases small-file write amplification. likely compounding.
liam: mitigation: 1) tag node `janitor:skip=1`, 2) drain high-churn GPU jobs to spare pool, 3) run short fio to confirm.
ops-bot: ACTION: auto-migration initiated for 2 jobs -> spare-pool-us-west3
rachel: applied skip tag and started drain. filing INFRA-4582 with SMART + logs.
devon: after skip, quick fio 4k randrw -> IOPS ~10.5k p95 15ms; when janitor runs, IOPS drops to ~1.7k p95 130ms. clear correlation.
liam: opening STOR-369 to add jitter + adaptive backoff to janitor cadence and recommend a staged rollback of overlayfs flags.
sofia: agree. avoid global rollback for now, prefer host-level mitigations and a watched canary.
rachel: follow-ups: keep skip for 24h, monitor SMART trend, consider vendor diag if media_errors continue.
aj: noted. scheduling watch and adding node to replacement candidate list if errors persist. thanks team.
